tool.name: Exome clinical interpretation report
tool.description: diagnostic, secondary, carrier, pharmacogenomic and risk findings in one human-readable report
tool.command: #if $bam: ln -s '$bam' input.bam && ln -s '${bam.metadata.bam_index}' input.bam.bai && #end if #if $reference: ln -s '$reference' reference.fa && samtools faidx reference.fa && #end if python3 '$__tool_directory__/wes_clinical_report.py' --vcf '$vcf' #if $sample_name and str($sample_name).strip(): --sample-name '$sample_name' #else: --sample-name '$vcf.element_identifier' #end if #if $gencc: --gencc '$gencc' #end if #if $constraint: --constraint '$constraint' #end if #if $hpo_genes: --hpo-genes '$hpo_genes' #end if #if $hpo_terms and str($hpo_terms).strip(): --hpo-terms '$hpo_terms' #end if #if $roh: --roh '$roh' #end if #if $artefacts: --artefacts '$artefacts' #end if #if $bam: --bam input.bam #end if #if $reference: --reference reference.fa #end if #if $target_coverage: --target-coverage '$target_coverage' #end if #if $gene_coverage: --gene-coverage '$gene_coverage' #end if #if $coverage_summary: --coverage-summary '$coverage_summary' #end if --max-af $max_af --min-ref-depth $min_ref_depth --max-candidates $max_candidates --html '$report' --tsv '$findings'

param.name: vcf
param.label: Annotated variants
param.help: Output of the WES tertiary workflow: SnpEff ANN/LOF/NMD, ClinVar CLNSIG/CLNREVSTAT/CLNDN, gnomAD v4.1 INFO/gnomAD_* fields.

param.name: sample_name
param.label: Sample name
param.help: Defaults to the dataset's element identifier.

param.name: gencc
param.label: Gene-disease validity (GenCC submissions TSV)
param.help: https://search.thegencc.org/download: gene-disease associations with mode of inheritance.

param.name: constraint
param.label: Gene constraint (gnomAD constraint metrics TSV)
param.help: gnomAD v4.1 constraint metrics (LOEUF, pLI, missense Z).

param.name: hpo_genes
param.label: HPO phenotype_to_genes.txt
param.help: HPO release file (propagated term to gene annotations).

param.name: hpo_terms
param.label: Patient phenotype (HPO terms)
param.help: Comma- or space-separated HPO ids, e.g. HP:0001250, HP:0001263. Used to rank candidates.

param.name: artefacts
param.label: Recurrent artefacts of the laboratory (VCF)
param.help: Alleles called in many of the laboratory's own samples but rare or absent in gnomAD (build_artefact_list.sh in the workflow repository). Matching calls are marked low confidence, not removed.

param.name: bam
param.label: Aligned reads (BAM)
param.help: Read depth at pharmacogenomic and risk-allele positions; without it, absent variants cannot be told apart from missing coverage.

param.name: reference
param.label: Reference genome (FASTA)
param.help: Repeat context (homopolymers, tandem repeats) of reported variants.

param.name: gene_coverage
param.label: Coding-exon coverage (mosdepth thresholds BED, gene in column 4)

param.name: max_af
param.label: Rare variant cut-off (population allele frequency)
param.help: Applied to the higher of the overall gnomAD AF and the grpmax filtering AF (FAF95).

param.name: min_ref_depth
param.label: Reads needed to read an uncalled pharmacogenomic position as reference

param.name: max_candidates
param.label: Candidate variants shown in the report (all are in the TSV)

tool.help:
**What it does**
Turns the annotated variants of one exome into a self-contained HTML report for review by a clinical scientist, plus a TSV of every finding. All conclusions come from explicit, versioned rules applied to the inputs (ClinVar, GenCC, gnomAD, HPO, CPIC allele tables); there is no statistical or language model involved.
Sections:
1. Sample and data quality: variant counts, Ts/Tv, het/hom ratio, allele-balance contamination hint, genetic sex (chrX heterozygosity, chrY coverage), target coverage. 2. Diagnostic findings: ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants whose genotype fits the gene's mode of inheritance (GenCC); a review table for genes with mixed or unknown inheritance and X-linked heterozygous females. 3. Candidate variants not classified in ClinVar: rare predicted loss-of-function variants in established disease genes (and rare missense variants in phenotype-matched genes), with automated ACMG/AMP evidence codes for triage. 4. ACMG SF v3.3 secondary findings (84 genes, gene-specific rules). 5. Carrier status for recessive conditions. 6. Pharmacogenomics: CPIC genes with single-nucleotide star alleles (CYP2C19, CYP2C9, VKORC1, CYP4F2, SLCO1B1, DPYD, TPMT, NUDT15, CYP3A5, CYP2B6, UGT1A1) and ClinVar drug-response variants. 7. Risk alleles (Factor V Leiden, prothrombin G20210A, HFE, APOE) and ClinVar risk/association variants. 8. Runs of homozygosity (bcftools roh). 9. Coverage of clinically relevant genes. 10. Methods and limitations.
Every flagged result must be confirmed by an orthogonal method in an accredited laboratory before clinical use.
